title: VUL Job Message
description: Triggers vulnerability scanning (CodeQL) for a single submission. VUL is stateless: all info provided in message, no DB access.

submission_id.description: PK of submissions table — included for logging/tracing context

file_url.description: MinIO pre-signed URL (TTL 6h) to download source code

language.description: CodeQL language identifier (from programming_languages.codeql_language). CodeQL uses 'cpp' for both C and C++. If codeql_language is null for a programming language, api does NOT publish VUL message — sets vuln_scan_status = 'not_applicable'.

trace_id.description: Cross-service tracing ID, generated by api
